author: Hannah Lee
text: The cinnamon knots are unreal. Came in for one, left with a box of six. The barista remembered my order from last week too!

author: Marcus T.
text: Waited 25 minutes for two lattes on a Tuesday afternoon. When they finally came they were lukewarm. Pastries looked great but I didn't stick around.

author: Priyanka S.
text: Lovely spot to work from, good wifi and the rye loaf is excellent. Only wish there were more outlets near the window seats.

author: Dave
text: Ordered a custom birthday cake two weeks ahead and it wasn't ready when I showed up at the agreed time. Had to go to the grocery store instead. Really disappointed.

author: Chloé Martin
text: Gluten-free options that actually taste good! The almond orange cake is my new favourite. Thank you for labelling allergens so clearly.

author: J. Okafor
text: Coffee is solid, prices are a bit steep for the portion sizes. Friendly staff though.

author: Robin K.
text: Sourdough is fantastic. Parking is a nightmare on weekends but that's not really your fault.
